scenarios.title: A cost set moved to REVIEW by a legacy writer is refused by the target review with CST0403

steps.sql: UPDATE cst.CostSet SET Status = 'REVIEW', ReviewedBy = 'COSTACC', ModifiedBy = 'COSTACC', ModifiedAt = SYSDATETIME() WHERE CompanyCode = 'STC' AND CostSetCode = 'FY2027DRAFT'; SELECT Status FROM cst.CostSet WHERE CompanyCode = 'STC' AND CostSetCode = 'FY2027DRAFT'

problem.detailContains: Cost set is REVIEW - it must be DRAFT for this action

assertions.sql: SELECT ReviewedBy FROM cst.CostSet WHERE CompanyCode = 'STC' AND CostSetCode = 'FY2027DRAFT'

scenarios.derivation: The legacy writer step reproduces the STDCOST 2000 REVIEW statement (UPDATE cst.CostSet SET Status = 'REVIEW', ReviewedBy, ModifiedBy, ModifiedAt; STDCOST.cob:286-406) on the freshc row FY2027DRAFT (DRAFT in the seed); the binding cst_reviewCostSet description requires status DRAFT else 422 CST0403 'Cost set is <status> - it must be DRAFT for this action', so the target applies the legacy status gate to rows changed by the legacy writer (contracts 4.9, 6.7).
